Geopolitics is in focus this week with the Quad leaders' meeting set to take place in Manila, and the G3 summit between Xi, Trump and Putin scheduled for November 18-19 in Shenzhen. PM Modi landed in Manila today, and will meet Trump during the Quad meeting.
Episode 1937 looks at the significance of these summits and why the world will be watching them closely. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also explains what are the three key aspects that concern India, and why.
